nodes.name: Load config
nodes.notes: Edit data/config.json and re-run build.mjs to change assets, rules or manuals.

nodes.name: Guard & redact
nodes.notes: Prompt-injection screening and PII redaction, before any model sees the text.

nodes.name: Input safe?
nodes.notes: Fails closed: unsafe input stops here and never reaches a model.

nodes.name: Resolve asset & retrieve manuals
nodes.notes: Registry match, then manual sections filtered by asset class. Chunked by section because the section id is the citation.

nodes.name: Azure OpenAI configured?
nodes.notes: With no key set the workflow still runs end to end on the built-in rules.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messages: [ { role: "system", content: $json.llmPrompt.system }, { role: "user", content: $json.llmPrompt.user } ], temperature: 0.1, max_tokens: 900, response_format: { type: "json_object" } }) }}

nodes.name: Azure OpenAI diagnosis
nodes.notes: On error the run continues; the parser downgrades confidence so a human is pulled in.

nodes.name: Parse diagnosis
nodes.notes: Validates the JSON and drops any citation the model did not actually receive.

nodes.name: Diagnose (built-in)
nodes.notes: Rule-based diagnosis over the same retrieved sections. Real logic, not a stub.

nodes.name: Score risk, apply policy & plan
nodes.notes: Deterministic: priority matrix, policy rules with citations, allow-listed action plan.

nodes.name: Needs human approval?
nodes.notes: The policy engine decides this, not the workflow author and not the model.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type: "message", attachments: [{ contentType: "application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive", content: { $schema: "http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json", type: "AdaptiveCard", version: "1.4", body: [ { type: "TextBlock", size: "Large", weight: "Bolder", text: $json.priority + " - " + ($json.asset ? $json.asset.name : "Unidentified asset") }, { type: "TextBlock", wrap: true, text: $json.diagnosis.summary }, { type: "TextBlock", wrap: true, isSubtle: true, text: "Held because: " + $json.approvalReason }, { type: "FactSet", facts: $json.findings.map(f => ({ title: f.ruleId, value: f.citation })) }, { type: "TextBlock", wrap: true, weight: "Bolder", text: "Proposed: " + $json.actions.map(a => a.label).join(", ") } ] } }] }) }}

nodes.name: Ask a supervisor in Teams
nodes.notes: Optional. Unset TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL and the run still completes.

nodes.name: Auto-dispatch
nodes.notes: Low-priority, high-confidence, reversible work only. Wire real connectors here.

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Input rejected before it reached a model. Nothing was diagnosed or dispatched.
